title: Kununu Top Companies Scraper
description: Browse Kununu top-company rankings with employer scores, review totals, recommendations, locations, benefits, and award details. Batch country markets and page through results.

batch.title: Countries
batch.description: Country markets whose ranked Kununu top-company lists you want to retrieve.
batch.valueDescription: Country used to run this search.

schema.description: Kununu country market code, such as de, at, or ch. Accepted values: de, at, ch.
Kununu top-company award year to request.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: number-reviews-desc.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Kununu top-company rankings. Export employer scores, review totals, recommendations, locations, benefits, and award details for research.
storeCopy.intro: Browse Kununu top-company rankings with employer scores, review totals, recommendation rates, locations, benefits, and award information. Batch country markets and page results.
useCases: Job seekers can discover highly rated employers in a market.
Recruiters can compare public employer scores and review totals.
Workplace analysts can study award, benefits, and recommendation data.
howToUse: Add a country code to each entry in `countries`.
Choose an award year, page, and sort order when needed.
Set `maxPages` and `maxResults` to bound the ranking collection.

faqs.question: Which country codes are supported?
faqs.answer: Kununu top-company data supports Germany, Austria, and Switzerland with `de`, `at`, and `ch`.
